companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Milestone One is a Site Enabling Services organization with global headquarters in Zug, Switzerland. We understand what clinical study sites need and our overall mission is to support sites in stronger study delivery.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Full-Stack Developer will design, build, and maintain the internal platforms, applications, and integrations that run Milestone One’s business. Our applications have a React/TypeScript front end, an API layer, and a database backend, hosted on Azure and integrated with Microsoft 365. We work data-first: we design and document the data structure, build the API from that specification, and then build the front end. You will work in a small team alongside AI coding agents, with security, data protection, and documented testing built into how we deliver.

Role responsibilities:

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
· Professional experience building web applications with React/TypeScript and a backend language such as C# / .NET (we welcome both experienced and early-career developers)

· SQL — schema design, data modelling, and writing efficient queries

· REST API design, authentication and authorization (Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect)

· Git branching, pull requests, and code review; CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps)

· Azure fundamentals — App Service, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Managed Identity

· Secure coding practices (e.g. OWASP Top 10) a
